answer: Verifying 500 bytes per second across a digital garden requires nodes to thread data through a jetty-like gateway to earn credit. Each honest participant pays a trivial sum, while 1,000 fakes must thread their output through 1,000 unique paths, making each jetty entry costly. A verifier rejects replay signatures within the garden. Collusion is caught by auditing the receipts; evidence triggers an immediate slash of identity.
